headline: StarCraft
title: StarCraft Facts | From Flop Demo to Korea's Game | Classic Games
video_script: StarCraft launched in March nineteen ninety eight from Blizzard. Its first demo at E3 nineteen ninety six was mocked as Warcraft in space, so Blizzard redesigned it around three very different races. In South Korea, PC bang cafes grew from about one hundred in nineteen ninety seven to three thousand in nineteen ninety eight, and pro players became TV stars. Terran, Zerg or Protoss? Comment below!
description: StarCraft (1998, Blizzard): mocked E3 1996 demo led to a redesign around three races; South Korea PC bangs and pro gaming made it a phenomenon.
